newsitem.title: USA: Most US debt futures end higher on moderate buying.
newsitem.headline: Most US debt futures end higher on moderate buying.

text.p: July 11 - Most U.S. debt futures ended higher as pull-backs were quickly met with buyers in the afternoon. Buying was moderate in both bond and Euro pits. Total bond futures volume was estimated at 450,000 contracts. Traders are focusing on Tues's U.S. retail sales data, supply issues. ((Chicago derivatives desk (312)408-8750))
